paragraphs: The XK 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 Gen III — a 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2005 to 2014 across the X150 generation of the XK, replacing the earlier X100-era AJ26/AJ27 engines. The AJ-V8 Gen III represents a significant evolution of Jaguar's V8 family, with improved timing chain components and revised cylinder heads compared to earlier iterations.
about.boldParagraph: The XK 4.2 V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
